findings.expected: A visible error on the Waterings page, no uncaught error
findings.actual: Uncaught 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function'; the app stays on the previous page (Tasks) with no message

findings.title: Dashboard shows 'No waterings yet' when the recent-waterings response is invalid
findings.expected: An error saying recent waterings could not be loaded
findings.actual: The empty state 'No waterings yet' is shown, so a failure looks like there is no data
findings.evidence: {"text":["Waterings","Add sowing, watering or pruning jobs to keep track of them here.","Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one."],"alerts":[]} | {"text":["Waterings","Add sowing, watering or pruning jobs to keep track of them here.","Recent waterings","All waterings","No waterings yet","Use “Water now” on a bed to record one."],"alerts":[]}

findings.title: While a bed filter loads, rows from other beds stay listed under the new filter
findings.expected: Only the selected bed's waterings (or no rows) while loading
findings.actual: With 'Shade corner' selected and 'Loading waterings…' showing, North bed rows are still listed. If the request hangs, this stays that way
findings.evidence: {"rows":["12 Nov 2026, 18:58\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","4 Mar 201\tShade corner\t3 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"alerts":["Loading waterings…"]} | {"rows":["12 Nov 2026, 18:58\tNorth bed\t–\tDelete","5 Nov 2026\tShade corner\t4 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t0 L\tDelete","1 Nov 2026\tNorth bed\t10 L\tDelete","4 Mar 201\tShade corner\t3 L\tDelete","1 Jan 1\tNorth bed\t1 L\tDelete"],"alerts":["Loading waterings…"]}

findings.title: No way to retry after the waterings list fails to load
findings.expected: A retry control after a load error
findings.actual: Only 'Injected 500' is shown, with no retry button. The user must change the filter or reload
findings.evidence: {"btns":0,"text":["Waterings","Every time a bed was watered.","Water a bed","Bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner","Clear filter","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]} | {"btns":0,"text":["Waterings","Every time a bed was watered.","Water a bed","Bed","All beds","North bed","Shade corner","Clear filter","Injected 500","Garden Log · a journal for one garden"]}

findings.title: Dashboard recent waterings has no retry after an error
findings.expected: A retry control in the section after a load error
findings.actual: An error alert with no button; refresh is not wired for waterings

findings.title: Tiny litre amounts accepted and shown as '0 L'
findings.expected: Amounts below the field's 0.1 minimum refused, or shown accurately
findings.actual: 0.001 is saved. The success message says 'Recorded 0 L on 1 Nov 2026.' and the list shows '0 L'
findings.evidence: ["Recorded 0 L on 1 Nov 2026."] | ["Recorded 0 L on 1 Nov 2026."]

findings.title: Far-past watering dates accepted (year 201)
findings.expected: An implausible date such as 0201-03-04 is refused with a reason
findings.actual: Saved, with the message 'Recorded 3 L on 4 Mar 201.' The API also accepts 0001-01-01, which then shows as '1 Jan 1'

findings.title: Bed filter select shows 'All beds' while a filter from the URL is applied
findings.expected: The select matches the applied filter, or an unknown bed is reported
findings.actual: The select shows 'All beds' while the page says 'No waterings for this bed' and shows 'Clear filter'
